title: Nothing can be dropped on an inactive or unenrolled technician
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 3 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Dana Ortiz") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  6. Create three Approved work orders for the case customer: one led by Esther Howard (e.g. "S1-702"), one led by Ralph Edwards (e.g. "S1-698") and one led by Dana Ortiz (e.g. "S1-691").
  7. Deactivate Esther Howard: Settings > Staff > Esther Howard > set the record Inactive > Save.
  8. Un-enrol Dana Ortiz from this location (Settings > Staff > Dana Ortiz > remove this location > Save); she stays Active.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  2. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  3. Find Esther Howard's column and Dana Ortiz's column (they stay because they lead matching work) and read their headers.
  4. Drag "S1-698" from Ralph Edwards' column onto Esther Howard's column.
  5. Drag "S1-698" onto Dana Ortiz's column.
  6. Repeat steps 4 and 5 in Tech View on the groups.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Esther Howard's column/group is still shown with her work order and is marked inactive.
  • Neither drop is accepted: "S1-698" returns to Ralph Edwards' column and its lead stays Ralph Edwards. The same happens in Tech View.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N5, read 8 Oct 2026. S2-N2/S3-N2 (deactivated lead keeps matching work visible). PO answer to engineering, Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026: technicians who are active but no longer eligible here are treated like inactive. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto an inactive technician's column/group (S2-N2, S3-N2).”
